results.description: Found documents, correlated by index into document_specs.

document_id.description: Indexed Glean store ID. Get document by ID accepts it.

url.description: Permalink of the document. Pass it to get document by URL to retrieve the document again. May differ from a submitted lookup URL.

title.description: Document title. The server returns the placeholder title, Untitled, when the source item has no title.

mime_type.description: Source MIME type. Omitted when absent.

creator.description: A lightweight reference to a person, used where a payload merely points at someone.
creator.title: PlatformPersonReference

owner.description: A lightweight reference to a person, used where a payload merely points at someone.
owner.title: PlatformPersonReference

updated_at.description: When the document was last modified.

content.description: Extracted text. Present on every found document when include contains CONTENT; omitted otherwise. A failure to retrieve requested content fails the request rather than returning a document without it.

full_text_list.description: Extracted plain-text segments. Empty when Glean has no extracted text for the document after a complete content read.

content.title: PlatformDocumentContent

warnings.description: Complete per-item failures. Empty when every spec was found.

code.description: Warning code such as resource_not_found or invalid_parameter.

document_id.description: Submitted document_id when the spec was an ID.

url.description: Submitted URL when the spec was a URL. Empty when the caller sent an empty url.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

400.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid parameter values, unknown fields).

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.

items.title: PlatformProblemDetailError
